title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: Your hands, one minute: in the Claude app, open Scheduled in the sidebar, choose the task 'ledger-page-answers-nightly' and switch it off. Since 10 November it stops each night at a permission question nobody can answer; the session already reads your answers back itself.
sections.recommendation: Switch it off: it has done nothing for three nights, and a session cannot change a schedule.

sections.name: A ruling, one tap (your yes in chat to the advisor, 11 Nov 22:15): when you pick something in your chat with the advisor, the advisor's message quoting your words and the time counts as your yes. Money, licences, canon and accounts still need your own tap here.
sections.recommendation: Yes: fewer taps for choices you have already made in chat; the big things still come here.

sections.name: A ruling, one tap (your yes in chat to the advisor, 11 Nov 22:15): a program you approve on this page may be installed by the session from the source named there, into the LedgerTools folders on C: or F: only, without you typing anything. If Windows' permission check still refuses, the item gives you the one line to type.
sections.recommendation: Yes: approved tools get installed the same hour instead of waiting for your hands.
